causal_chain: IBAN format errors occur during refund payment processing
These errors cause refund transactions to fail with status FAILED_IBAN_FORMAT
Failed refunds trigger customers to submit inquiries about their refund status
Increased inquiry volume leads to perceived wait time for refund answers

assumptions.statement: Refund failures due to IBAN format errors lead to customer inquiries about refund status.
Perceived wait time for refund answers is driven by the volume of refund-related inquiries.

No evidence of support queue buildup; ticket response time median is well below SLA, rejecting staffing shortage as cause.

output.root_cause: IBAN format errors in refund payments cause refund failures, which generate customer inquiries about refund status and increase perceived wait time.

remedies.description: Add IBAN format validation step before payment submission in the refund process (process/config change) to prevent IBAN format errors (E-02, H-IBAN-FORMAT-ERRORS).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Runtime shows 225 minutes budget remaining; a simple validation rule can be implemented within this window (state.runtime.budget_remaining_minutes).
remedies.residual_gap: Perceived wait may persist due to other inquiry drivers such as refund policy complexity (H-REFUND-PROCESS-COMPLEXITY) and stakeholder-reported wait (E-03). Structural fix does not address those sources, so a gap remains in perceived wait reduction unless further measures are taken. (H-REFUND-PROCESS-COMPLEXITY, E-03).
